correctness.rationale: The final claim is correct with non-effective scope. Li gives complex exact unrestricted/symmetric ranks (110,112) and (165,168) for k=2,3 of Lovitz’s rational 27-dimensional tensor. Lovitz gives rational upper decompositions of sizes 55 and 56 per block. For any characteristic-zero K, finite coefficients of a hypothetically shorter K-decomposition generate a finitely generated Q-subfield E which embeds in C; this contradicts Li. The same applies to scalar-weighted cubes, not merely cubes with unit weights. The rank-at-most equations are finite polynomial systems over a localization of Z; their absence of C-solutions yields rational Hilbert-Nullstellensatz certificates. Clearing denominators in certificates and rational upper decompositions excludes finitely many primes, proving ranks over all K of remaining characteristics. No exceptional-prime list or explicit certificate is asserted. The local transfer_check.py merely reproduces 55k/56k arithmetic and counts polynomial variables, and cannot establish Li’s external lower bounds.

originality.rationale: The result is already logically implied by Li’s exact complex double/triple ranks, Lovitz’s explicit rational upper decompositions, and the general elementary field-transfer/Nullstellensatz principle. The first input fixes the lower bound, the second fixes the upper bound, and the general no-zero certificate argument automatically yields all but finitely many reduction characteristics for ANY fixed rational polynomial existence system. The extension to every characteristic-zero field and a non-effective cofinite-prime set contains no further tensor-specific invariant, explicit exceptional prime or new lower bound; it is an immediate specialized consequence of the published stronger input statements and standard general machinery. The wording need not occur in either source to be prior-covered. This is a substantive originality failure, not a declaration that the mathematics is false or that inaccessible literature alone defeats priority.

value.rationale: Arithmetic stability of the first explicit low-dimensional Comon gap-two/gap-three examples is a natural fact that a tensor-rank researcher may need, since rank generally depends on the field. Specifying exact persistence across every characteristic-zero field and cofinitely many primes is meaningful even without an explicit exceptional set. Thus its interpretation is useful, although usefulness cannot compensate for the lack of a new mathematical implication beyond the source ranks plus generic polynomial transfer.
